name: Thurston Manor Holiday Park
accommodation: Caravans, lodges, glamping pods, hot tub stays and touring pitches
suitableFor: Families and tourers wanting a pool and on-site facilities
dogs: Dog-friendly pub and bar areas; pets field on booking
beachAccess: At Innerwick near Dunbar, a short drive up the coast from Pease Bay
confirmedFeatures: Indoor pool, gym, games room, bars and restaurant, play park, fly fishing
overview: Thurston Manor is a holiday park at Innerwick near Dunbar, open from mid-February to December. It has caravans, lodges, pods and hot tub stays, plus touring pitches. Facilities include an indoor pool, gym, bars and a restaurant. Pease Bay is a short drive down the A1.
surfTripFit: It offers more facilities and touring pitches than the beachfront park while staying a short drive from Pease Bay.
